feats.title: Hunter's Advantage
feats.description: Your Hunter's Quarry damage increases by 2 against a quarry granting you combat advantage.

feats.title: Opportunistic Archer
feats.description: When Combat Challenge grants a melee basic attack, you may instead make a ranged basic attack with a bow against that target. This attack provokes no opportunity attacks.

feats.title: Prime Slayer
feats.description: Gain +2 to ranged damage rolls against a target if no ally is closer to it than you.
